description: This Java source file defines the OrderSetAttribute class, which represents a user-defined attribute associated with an OrderSet in the OpenMRS healthcare framework. It includes methods to get and set the attribute's ID and owner OrderSet, and integrates with Hibernate for auditing.

classes.name: OrderSetAttribute
classes.description: Represents a user-defined attribute linked to an OrderSet, extending BaseAttribute and implementing Attribute, with Hibernate auditing support.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the OrderSetAttribute.

methods.name: setOrderSetAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the OrderSetAttribute.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Retrieves the OrderSet to which this attribute belongs.

methods.name: setOrderSet
methods.description: Assigns an OrderSet to this attribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the identifier, delegating to getOrderSetAttributeId().

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier, delegating to setOrderSetAttributeId().
